launch_readiness: RESOLVED 2026-09-26: resource envelope SET and real-CLI launch wrappers shipped (tests/evaluation/v6/adapters_launch/) — rounds r1-r3 ran under both. Confirmation-era configs carry machine-checked readiness fields only; readiness prose lives in PILOT.md (D15 F10).

tasks.prompt: Add tag archives at /tags/<tag>/ with stable URLs linked from every post's tags, plus pagination on /blog/ at 3 posts per page preserving post URLs. Acceptance: archive pages exist for existing tags, pagination links both directions, no existing post URL changes, and 'pnpm run check' passes.

Add a small client-side search box on /blog/ filtering post titles, with a useful empty state. Acceptance: the built page contains the search control and data, filtering is verifiable in the served DOM, empty and no-match states render human-readable text.

Give every page a canonical URL and preserve RSS/sitemap integrity; add a permanent redirect from /posts/<slug>/ to /blog/<slug>/. Acceptance: canonicals match final routes, RSS and sitemap enumerate built posts with resolving URLs, /posts/first-post/ redirects to /blog/first-post/.

Add a visible skip-to-content link and make the nav fully keyboard-operable with a visible focus style. Acceptance: the skip link is the first focusable element and moves focus to main; every nav item is keyboard-operable; the focus style is visible in built CSS.
